e.title: 澳新保险学会（ANZIIF）
e.title_en: Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance (ANZIIF)
e.summary: 澳新保险与金融专业团体：按领域组织（理赔/一般保险/经纪/再保/风险管理/寿险）的资格与 CPD
e.summary_en: The Australia/New Zealand insurance and finance professional body: qualifications and CPD organised by sector (claims, general insurance, broking, reinsurance, risk management, life)
e.summary_hk: 澳新保險與金融專業團體：按領域組織（理賠/一般保險/經紀/再保/風險管理/壽險）的資格與 CPD
e.body: 澳新保险学会（Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance, ANZIIF，`anziif.com`）是**澳大利亚与新西兰保险及金融服务业的教育与专业团体**，也是亚太地区影响最广的保险专业资格与持续教育提供方之一。其站内结构价值很高：**按领域（View by Sector）**组织内容——理赔（Claims）、一般保险（General Insurance）、保险经纪（Insurance Broking）、**再保险（Reinsurance）**、风险管理（Risk Management）、寿险与退休收入（Life and Retirement Income）；专业发展侧提供短期课程、**资格（Qualifications）**、技能单元、合规课程、网络研讨会与点播活动，并出版 **The Journal**（行业期刊）；另设**先前学习认可（Recognition of Prior Learning, RPL）**、学术日历与评估体系，以及「Your Career in Insurance」职业路径指南。对 RIAA：这是「**保险实务的体系化学习路径**」在亚太的样板——尤其它的**按险种/职能分域组织**方式，正好对应对口岗位（[[underwriter]] 核保、[[claims-specialist]] 理赔、[[insurance-broker]] 经纪）；与英国体系的 [[cii]]、美国寿险运营方向的 [[loma]] 构成三大保险专业团体参照系，精算侧见 [[actuaries-institute]]；市场数据侧可接 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]；适合作职业路径规划、实务技能与亚太市场方向。
e.body_en: The Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance (ANZIIF, `anziif.com`) is **the education and professional body for insurance and financial services in Australia and New Zealand**, and one of the most influential providers of insurance qualifications and continuing education in the Asia-Pacific. Its site structure is notably useful: content is organised **by sector** — Claims, General Insurance, Insurance Broking, **Reinsurance**, Risk Management, and Life and Retirement Income; the professional development side offers short courses, **qualifications**, skills units, compliance courses, webinars and on-demand events, and it publishes **The Journal**; it also operates **Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)**, an academic calendar and an assessment system, plus a "Your Career in Insurance" pathway guide. For RIAA: a template for **systematic learning pathways in insurance practice** in Asia-Pacific — especially its organisation by line of business and function, which maps directly onto counterpart roles ([[underwriter]], [[claims-specialist]], [[insurance-broker]]); with the UK system’s [[cii]] and the US life-operations-oriented [[loma]] it forms a three-way reference frame of insurance professional bodies, while the actuarial side is [[actuaries-institute]]; market data can connect to [[apra-insurance-statistics]]; suits career-path planning, practical skills and Asia-Pacific market work.
e.body_hk: 澳新保險學會（Australian and New Zealand Institute of Insurance and Finance, ANZIIF，`anziif.com`）是**澳大利亞與紐西蘭保險及金融服務業的教育與專業團體**，也是亞太地區影響最廣的保險專業資格與持續教育提供方之一。其站內結構價值很高：**按領域（View by Sector）**組織內容——理賠、一般保險、保險經紀、**再保險**、風險管理、壽險與退休收入；專業發展側提供短期課程、**資格**、技能單元、合規課程、網絡研討會與點播活動，並出版 **The Journal**；另設**先前學習認可（RPL）**、學術日曆與評估體系。對 RIAA：這是「**保險實務的體系化學習路徑**」在亞太的樣板——其按險種/職能分域的組織方式正好對應對口崗位（[[underwriter]]、[[claims-specialist]]、[[insurance-broker]]）；與英國體系的 [[cii]]、美國壽險運營方向的 [[loma]] 構成三大保險專業團體參照系，精算側見 [[actuaries-institute]]；市場數據側可接 [[apra-insurance-statistics]]；適合作職業路徑規劃、實務技能與亞太市場方向。
